Name: Wine Sodas for Artisanal Soda Makers
Author: QuillSnow
Description:
[center][i]Presenting Wine Sodas: Diversify your soda empire with unique, refined products that appeal to a sophisticated palate. Produce and sell unique colas, cream sodas and sodas with delightful flavour profiles and aromas that evoke imagery of the vineyards of the world. Now completely redone for Content Patcher, with shiny new original art!

[img]https://u.cubeupload.com/Quillex_/WineSodasFeatures.png[/img]﻿
[/i][Alt Text: A purple banner flanked by syrup bottles, with light-coloured text saying "Features".]

This mod allows you to use the grapes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5912]Stardew Vineyard[/url]﻿ to make colas, cream sodas, sodas, and syrups using the machines added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url]﻿. Start your wine soda empire today using the following simple recipes:

[code]Cream Sodas: Place 1 wine grape of your choice, 1 sparkling water, 1 sugar, and 1 vanilla extract into the Cream Soda Maker.
Sodas: Place 1 wine grape, 1 sparkling water, and 1 sugar into the Soda Maker.
﻿Syrups: Place 1 wine grape and 1 sugar into the Syrup Maker.
Colas: Place 1 sparkling water, 1 wine grape syrup, and 1 kola nut into the Cola Maker.
[/code]
This mod adds one cola, syrup, cream soda, and soda item for each of the 21 grapes added by Stardew Vineyard - that's [i]84[/i] artisan goods for you to produce and sell!

[img]https://u.cubeupload.com/Quillex_/WineSodasComingSoon.png[/img]﻿
[Alt Text: A purple banner flanked by syrup bottles, with light-coloured text saying "Coming Soon".]

The roadmap for Wine Sodas includes:
>> Modded NPC gift tastes!
>> Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿ - Soon, sodas and colas from this mod will be available for purchase at Ari's shop!

[img]https://u.cubeupload.com/Quillex_/WineSodasRequirement.png[/img]﻿
[Alt Text: A purple banner flanked by syrup bottles, with light-coloured text saying "Requirements".]

Wine Sodas requires the following mods to work:
>> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. Without this, the mod doesn't load.
>> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url]﻿. This is a mandatory requirement for Artisanal Soda Makers.
>> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5912]Stardew Vineyard[/url]. Without this, there are no grapes for you to make wine sodas with.

[img]https://u.cubeupload.com/Quillex_/WineSodasInstallatio.png[/img]﻿
[Alt Text: A purple banner flanked by syrup bottles, with light-coloured text saying "Installation".]

>> Install SMAPI
>> Install all the requirements I've listed.
>> Download the latest release from the Files tab, and unzip to your Mods folder.
>> Profit!

>> Report any bugs you might find related to this mod in the Bugs tab. Attach a SMAPI log and a description of what's going wrong (and an image if the problem is visual!) - if you don't provide a log and a description of the problem, I will not be able to provide any kind of assistance.

[img]https://u.cubeupload.com/Quillex_/WineSodasPermissions.png[/img]﻿
[Alt Text: A purple banner flanked by syrup bottles, with light-coloured text saying "Permissions".]

[b]Important Note: My Nexus DMs are closed, and I do not use them. Please do not contact me for permissions using my Nexus DMs. All Nexus DMs inquiries will be ignored.[/b]
>> All art in this mod is my own. If you want to use my art in your projects, ping me in the Stardew Valley Discord server's modmaking channels, the Sunberry Village Discord server, or in the Stardew Modmaking Community Discord server - my discord user is @quillex_.
>> Feel free to reference my jsons for your own modding projects!
>> If you would like to discuss adding gift tastes for your custom NPCs or other collaborations, please don't hesitate to reach out! I'd love to discuss compatibility with you.
>> Notes for translators: You may upload your i18n translations of this mod yourself and enable DP on your translations. Just make sure your translation requires the original mod and does not include my mod's files. DO NOT MACHINE-TRANSLATE THIS MOD, PLEASE.
>> I do not consent to the use of my work for generative AI model training purposes.
>> Do not upload fixes or patches for my mods without my permission.

[img]https://u.cubeupload.com/Quillex_/WineSodasSpecialThan.png[/img]﻿
[Alt Text: A purple banner flanked by syrup bottles, with light-coloured text saying "Special Thanks".]

>> Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/hadiwrites42?gameId=1303]Hadi[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Amburr?gameId=1303]Amburr[/url]﻿ for their making Artisanal Soda Makers and Stardew Vineyard, respectively. Without them, this mod could not exist.
